family_reports.body: The psychological and financial abuse should be considered family terrorism because thats EXACTLY what it is. They terrorize you mentally then extort your hard earned money and savings on the "best interest of the child." The years of therapy I have been through has only made it somewhat bearable.

Family court has destroyed the innocence and robbed the dreams of my children and my motherhood. Family court has become the abuser and the weapon of my abuser. Family court is responsible for creating poverty homelessness and generational trauma.
